description: C1: the first standing stone of the colossi, on its rise in the Hoarfell beyond the rim: grows a giant to stage 7 and, on its own condition, stage 8 (max_stage 8). Its growth conditions are the stages' own (each profile's growth_requirement, decision C1-3): stage 7 once act two has begun and the stone is reached; stage 8 once the Colossus's Trials are done (milestone D replaces both with the Frostbound and the Stormcaller slain). A checkpoint, a rest and the loadout.
